title: Blue-Green Deployment Pattern — Runnable Implementations
description: Runnable blue-green deployment simulation in three languages (Python, JavaScript, Java): environment state machine, smoke-test gate, instant traffic switch and one-step rollback.
description_es: Simulación ejecutable del despliegue blue-green en tres lenguajes (Python, JavaScript, Java): máquina de estados de entornos, puerta de smoke tests, conmutación instantánea de tráfico y rollback en un paso.
